start.card:
You put $1,000 in a savings account that pays 7% interest a year.
Interest is money the bank pays you for keeping your money there. 7% means $7 for every $100 you have, each year.
You leave it alone for 30 years. Roughly how much is there at the end? Make a guess first.
start.title: Interest on interest

afterGuess.card:
You guessed $5.00. Now let's grow the money one year at a time. Each coin is $100.
Compound stack (left): every year it earns 7% of everything in it, old interest included.
Simple stack (right): every year it earns 7% of the first $1,000 only.
Press "Next year".
afterGuess.title: Interest on interest

after.card:
Year 28 of 30. This year the compound stack earned $434.97; the simple stack earned $70.00.
Watch the brackets: the compound stack's yearly growth keeps getting bigger. Playing one year at a time…
after.title: Interest on interest
